constructor_defaults_and_preserved_shell.quote:
class JsonResponse(HttpResponse):
    """
    An HTTP response class that consumes data to be serialized to JSON.

    :param data: Data to be dumped into json. By default only ``dict`` objects
      are allowed to be passed due to a security flaw before ECMAScript 5. See
      the ``safe`` parameter for more information.
    :param encoder: Should be a json encoder class. Defaults to
      ``django.core.serializers.json.DjangoJSONEncoder``.
    :param safe: Controls if only ``dict`` objects may be serialized. Defaults
      to ``True``.
    :param json_dumps_params: A dictionary of kwargs passed to json.dumps().
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        data,
        encoder=DjangoJSONEncoder,
        safe=True,
        json_dumps_params=None,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        if safe and not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise TypeError(
                "In order to allow non-dict objects to be serialized set the "
                "safe parameter to False."
            )
        if json_dumps_params is None:
            json_dumps_params = {}
        kwargs.setdefault("content_type", "application/json")
        data = json.dumps(data, cls=encoder, **json_dumps_params)
        super().__init__(content=data, **kwargs)

def render(
    request, template_name, context=None, content_type=None, status=None, using=None
):
    """
    Return an HttpResponse whose content is filled with the result of calling
    django.template.loader.render_to_string() with the passed arguments.
    """
    content = loader.render_to_string(template_name, context, request, using=using)
    return HttpResponse(content, content_type, status)

def __init__(self, *args, user, language="es", **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        english = language == "en"
        self.fields["listing"].label = "Listing" if english else "Anuncio"
        self.fields["product"].label = "Test product" if english else "Producto de prueba"
        self.fields["confirm"].label = (
            "I understand this is a simulation with no charge"
            if english
            else "Entiendo que es una simulación sin cobro"
        )
        self.fields["product"].language = language
        from apps.listings.models import Listing

        self.fields["listing"].queryset = Listing.objects.filter(
            person__in=person_queryset(user), status="published"
        ).select_related("person")
        self.fields["product"].queryset = PromotionProductVersion.objects.filter(
            product__active=True,
            is_current=True,
            published_at__isnull=False,
            amount__gt=0,
            currency="EUR",
            tax_rate__isnull=False,
        ).select_related("product")

def __init__(self, *args, language="es", **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.language = language
        self.documents = docs(language)
        for doc in self.documents:
            self.fields[f"version_{doc.slug}"] = forms.CharField(
                widget=forms.HiddenInput, initial=doc.version
            )

        if language == "en":
            self.fields["password"].label = "Password"
            self.fields["accept_terms"].label = "I accept the terms of use"
            self.fields["privacy_notice"].label = "I have read the privacy information"
        else:
            self.fields["password"].label = "Contraseña"
            self.fields["accept_terms"].label = "Acepto las condiciones de uso"
            self.fields["privacy_notice"].label = "He leído la información de privacidad"
        self.fields["password"].widget.attrs["autocomplete"] = "new-password"
        self.fields["email"].widget.attrs["autocomplete"] = "email"

def __init__(self, *args, case, actor, language=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        localize_form(self, language)
        self.fields.pop("kind")
        self.fields["scope_inventory"].queryset = (
            RightsAccessScopeInventory.objects.filter(
                request=case,
                actor=actor,
                case_version=case.version,
                response_version=case.response_version,
                purged_at__isnull=True,
                expires_at__gt=timezone.now(),
            )
            .only("pk")
            .order_by("-pk")
        )

        self.fields["coverage_review"].queryset = (
            RightsAccessCoverageReview.objects.filter(
                coverage__request=case,
                coverage__actor=actor,
                coverage__case_version=case.version,
                coverage__response_version=case.response_version,
                coverage__purged_at__isnull=True,
                coverage__expires_at__gt=timezone.now(),
                outcome="approved",
            )
            .only("pk")
            .order_by("-pk")
        )

        self.fields["export"].queryset = (
            RightsExport.objects.filter(
                action__request=case,
                action__actor=actor,
                information_binding__review__outcome="approved",
                expires_at__gt=timezone.now(),
                purged_at__isnull=True,
            )
            .only("pk")
            .order_by("-created_at")
        )

def __init__(self, *args, case, actor, language=None, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, language=language, **kwargs)
        if language is not None:
            field = self.fields["coverage_review"]
            field.help_text = caption(field.help_text, language)
        self.fields["review"].queryset = (
            RightsPortabilitySelectionReview.objects.filter(
                selection__request=case,
                selection__actor=actor,
                outcome="approved",
                selection__purged_at__isnull=True,
                selection__expires_at__gt=timezone.now(),
            )
            .select_related("selection")
            .only("pk", "selection_id", "selection__version")
            .order_by("-pk")
        )
        self.fields["coverage_review"].queryset = (
            RightsPortabilityCoverageReview.objects.filter(
                coverage__request=case,
                coverage__actor=actor,
                outcome="approved",
                coverage__purged_at__isnull=True,
                coverage__expires_at__gt=timezone.now(),
            )
            .select_related("coverage")
            .only("pk", "coverage_id", "coverage__version")
            .order_by("-pk")
        )

limits: Application/Django code is parsed, never imported or executed; no tests or services run.
Local inheritance recorded recursively; external framework inheritance/defaults remain unknown.
Literal/name/subscript/static-sequence/concatenation and model-enum declarations may resolve; calls/comprehensions/querysets remain source rules with referenced choice constants when local.
Declared choices are not approved Cartesian combinations or authority to perform an operation.
Dynamic constructor rules and full local methods are source-backed; effective options depend on actor/state/data and are not enumerated.
Direct local validation/constructor/save helpers included; transitive service validation and model clean/signals/database constraints are not claimed exhaustive.
Model fields are declarations only; Django-generated fields, inherited model fields and conversions are unresolved where not explicit.
Route IDs reuse current census source identity; routes and scanner are not re-executed.
Source hashes checked before/after; commit identity comes from task/census rather than Git execution.

handler_specific_limits.statement: Autenticación, account_version, documentos, MFA y headers no conceden pertenencia, finalidad, permiso de objeto, conflicto de interés, versión, idempotencia ni lectura auditada. Cada ruta y servicio debe conservar sus fuentes pertinentes, especialmente antes de lectura/descifrado/efecto tras esperas. No se inventaría el grafo completo de handlers en este insumo.

No existe aquí promesa general GET sin mutación. Los decoradores se declaran por handler; AccountGate puede enlazar epoch0 en GET y sesiones/framework tienen política propia. La lectura privada POST auditada se contrasta por ruta, no se deduce del helper private().

En apps/safety/views.py se leyó sólo private() e imports pertinentes; no se revisaron submit/receipt/queue/inspect/decision ni formularios. El nombre credentials solicitado no existe como definición o identificador en este archivo actual; no se amplió el alcance para inventar un wrapper.

identity.identity_basis: Commit labels supplied by root; no Git executed. Current source identity independently SHA256 hashed before/after reading and before output.

account_flows.expected_behavior: Signin autentica con backend Django y exige email_verified_at; login enlaza account_version al User admitido y redirige dashboard.
account_flows.frontend_preserve: Conservar contraseña real y posterior challenge MFA según middleware; no marcar sesión como MFA por completar signin.
account_flows.limits: El backend de autenticación/config efectiva no se ejecutó ni se asumen sus defaults.

account_flows.expected_behavior: El digest de estado del token liga email/password/session_version; POST vuelve a bloquear User/token y comprueba uso/caducidad/estado. Reset cambia contraseña e incrementa session_version; verifica email activa cuenta sólo en la rama verify.
account_flows.frontend_preserve: Conservar enlace como capacidad privada, preview y confirmación, token de un uso y validación de servidor.
account_flows.limits: No transportar secretos a URL de terceros; límites del handler y no-store no son prueba de entrega externa.

citations.quote: # Never trust forwarded IP headers without an explicitly configured proxy.

account_flows.expected_behavior: limited usa REMOTE_ADDR sin confiar en cabeceras reenviadas por el solicitante; HMAC por acción/IP, fila RateWindow bloqueada, ventana15min y attempts incrementado.
account_flows.frontend_preserve: Presentar429 y evitar reintento automático agresivo; no añadir XFF de cliente como supuesto remedio.
account_flows.limits: La identidad IP efectiva depende del proxy/config de despliegue no revisados; intentos de login/MFA pueden producir escritura RateWindow legítima.

citations.quote: # Identical response for an existing address. No privilege changes or password overwrite.

account_flows.expected_behavior: Alta existente responde igual sin sobreescribir privilegios o contraseña; recover/resend devuelven account_sent con independencia de encontrar cuenta elegible. Fallo SMTP/OSError se registra como account_email_delivery_failed.
account_flows.frontend_preserve: No mostrar existencia de cuenta ni interpretar account_sent como recepción externa probada.
account_flows.limits: Backend de correo es dinámico; esta tarea no acredita envío ni contenido de proveedor.

admin.expected_behavior: Receiver user_logged_in sender=User con dispatch_uid estable sólo enlaza account_version si POST y resolver namespace admin/url_name login. Usa user.session_version recibido, sin recargar User.
